name: The Placement
description: A volunteer travel operator — 2,140 volunteers a year, 17-day placements, €4.24 million revenue, 6.8% net margin — receives two letters in the same week. Its largest university partner will withdraw accreditation from any placement that fails four evidence tests, and the programme that fails all four is 43% of gross profit. Its strongest host partner, a Guatemalan agroforestry cooperative whose director has read the operator’s impact report more carefully than its board, will not renew on the current terms and holds a veto. Round 1 audits the five-programme portfolio on evidence and cash; Round 2 renegotiates with the host partner, who exits if her floor is not met; Round 3 redesigns the portfolio against the four tests and a cash constraint that makes purity insolvent; Round 4 rewrites the impact claims the customer reads and sets price and segment. Teaches value-chain leakage, host-community agency versus consultation, the harm evidence on short-duration volunteering, and how an ethical decision is only tested when it is expensive.

Briefing

Round 1 — Audit (20 min)

Five programmes, two axes: what each contributes to gross profit, and how it stands against the university’s four tests. Give each a disposition. The cash effect appears as you go.

ProgrammeVol/yrFeeGross marginEvidence base
Casa Luz residential childcare support, two countries410€2,340€412,000 · 43%Fails all four tests. The research consensus on short-term volunteering in residential childcare is unambiguous and negative.
Construcción Comunitaria school and clinic building620€1,890€289,000Weak. Unskilled volunteers build slower and worse than local masons who need the work.
Ixchel Ruk’u’x agroforestry and coffee cooperative340€1,760€94,000Strong. Host-defined, seasonal, skills-matched, no labour displacement. The partner sets the terms.
Costa Verde Conservación sea turtle monitoring, Ecuador490€1,840€131,000Moderate to good. Real data collection, low skill floor, dependent on volume.
Aula Abierta English teaching in state schools280€2,010€71,000Weak to moderate. Rotating untrained teachers on 17-day cycles; the schools want continuity and get churn.

Round 2 — Renegotiate (20 min)

Marisol Quiej Tzoc takes her seat, and she has a veto. Her opening position is on the table. If there is no agreement by the end of the round, the cooperative exits with its 340 placements, its reputation and its photographs.

Her proposal
The cooperative sets the placement calendar, defines the work, employs the coordinators directly, and takes €740 per volunteer as unrestricted funds. Verder recruits, screens, arranges travel and insurance — for a defined fee rather than a residual margin. She notes that the only thing Verder supplies which the cooperative cannot replicate is European customer acquisition.

Round 3 — Redesign (20 min)

Rebuild the portfolio against the four tests and a cash constraint. Every reform lengthens the product and shrinks the market. The option with the best evidence has the worst brochure.

Cash after redesign

Round 4 — Sell It (20 min)

The reformed portfolio meets the customer. Rewrite the three assets that carry the claims, then set price and segment. Honest copy converts worse — at first.

summary.en: As Femke Hoekstra, managing director of volunteer travel operator Verder Reizen, you face a key university partner that will drop placements failing four evidence tests and a Guatemalan host cooperative that will not renew on current terms, and you redesign programmes, claims and price.
summary.es: Como Femke Hoekstra, directora general del operador de voluntariado Verder Reizen, afrontas a una universidad socia que retirará las plazas que no superen cuatro pruebas de evidencia y a una cooperativa anfitriona guatemalteca que no renovará; rediseñas programas, mensajes de impacto y precio.

text.en: Evaluate a programme portfolio on contribution to gross margin and evidence of benefit to the host at once, and price the cost of acting when the two point in opposite directions
text.es: Evaluar una cartera de programas a la vez por su contribución al margen bruto y por la evidencia de beneficio para la comunidad anfitriona, y valorar el coste de actuar cuando ambas apuntan en direcciones opuestas

text.en: Negotiate with a host partner who holds a veto and a credible outside option, distinguishing voice from terms and control, and restructure how the operator is paid
text.es: Negociar con un socio anfitrión que tiene derecho de veto y una alternativa creíble, distinguiendo tener voz de fijar condiciones y control, y reestructurar cómo cobra el operador

text.en: Redesign a volunteer-travel product against external evidence tests and a cash floor, avoiding both cosmetic reform and insolvent purity
text.es: Rediseñar un producto de voluntariado frente a pruebas externas de evidencia y un mínimo de caja, evitando tanto la reforma cosmética como la pureza insolvente

text.en: Assess which impact claims the operator's own figures can support, and weigh the commercial and consumer-protection exposure of the claims they cannot
text.es: Valorar qué afirmaciones de impacto pueden respaldar las propias cifras del operador, y sopesar la exposición comercial y de protección al consumidor de las que no

text.en: Critique what the simulation's scoreboard rewards against what a defensible recommendation requires, and state what the score does not count
text.es: Criticar lo que premia el marcador de la simulación frente a lo que exige una recomendación defendible, y señalar lo que la puntuación no cuenta

name.en: The four-minute keep: relabel Casa Luz as a redesign and bank the cash
name.es: El mantenimiento de cuatro minutos: llamar rediseño a Casa Luz y quedarse con la caja

lure.en: The first screen shows a profit of about €155,000 against a loss of about €74,000 for closing, and a redesign sounds like reform
lure.es: La primera pantalla muestra un beneficio de unos 155.000 € frente a una pérdida de unos 74.000 € si se cierra, y un rediseño suena a reforma

consequence.en: The residential childcare placements continue, the university withdraws its 380 students, and the run should not read as reformed
consequence.es: Las plazas en hogares residenciales continúan, la universidad retira a sus 380 estudiantes y la partida no debería leerse como reformada

name.en: Offering voice instead of terms: an advisory seat and a partial payment
name.es: Ofrecer voz en lugar de condiciones: un asiento asesor y un pago parcial

lure.en: An advisory seat is listed first, sounds generous and costs nothing, and €400 nearly doubles the €214 she receives now
lure.es: El asiento asesor aparece primero, suena generoso y no cuesta nada, y 400 € casi duplican los 214 € que recibe ahora

consequence.en: The cooperative exits with its 340 placements; the strongest-evidence line goes to zero and the run is capped
consequence.es: La cooperativa se va con sus 340 plazas; la línea con mejor evidencia queda a cero y la partida queda limitada

source.ref: TN §13 (voice instead of terms), §7 Q2, TN-Exhibit 4 (Voice, not terms)

name.en: Purity without arithmetic: a 42-day minimum with delivery kept in-house
name.es: Pureza sin aritmética: un mínimo de 42 días con la operación en manos propias

lure.en: Longer placements improve every impact measure, and keeping delivery protects the coordinators' jobs
lure.es: Las estancias largas mejoran todas las medidas de impacto, y mantener la operación protege los empleos de los coordinadores

consequence.en: The market shrinks by about 64% while the overheads stay; the portfolio falls below the cash floor and the run is capped as insolvent
consequence.es: El mercado se reduce un 64% mientras los gastos generales se mantienen; la cartera cae por debajo del mínimo de caja y la partida queda limitada por insolvencia

name.en: Keeping the claim while changing the programme
name.es: Mantener la afirmación mientras se cambia el programa

lure.en: The old sentence converts best, and "it depends on the placement" keeps accreditation without the cost of a plain no
lure.es: La frase antigua es la que mejor convierte, y "depende de la plaza" conserva la acreditación sin el coste de un no claro

consequence.en: The website keeps a claim the operator's own page 14 contradicts, the exposure a journalist or regulator finds first
consequence.es: La web mantiene una afirmación que la propia página 14 del operador contradice, la exposición que un periodista o un regulador encuentra primero

source.ref: TN §13 (keeping the claim while changing the programme), §7 Q4, TN-Exhibit 8
